title: List lookup yields an indexed entry
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean list, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $v$ be Boolean. If the optional lookup of $w$ at index $i$ returns $v$, then $i$ is less than the length of $w$ and the entry of $w$ at index $i$ is $v$.
hypotheses_covered: The optional lookup of $w$ at index $i$ returns $v$
